v8-53a.display:
Then Solomon spoke concerning the house when he had finished building it:
“The Lord made the sun known in heaven;

continuations.display:
He spoke of dwelling in gloom:
‘Build My house, a splendid house for yourself,
to dwell in newness.’
Is this not written in the Book of Song?”
